honest_pf_demo.headline: Aggregate PF can flatter. Avg Daily PF shows whether edge repeats day after day.
honest_pf_demo.method_note: Finite daily PF values are averaged. Fully profitable zero-loss days are reported separately and excluded from the finite mean.

evidence_blocks.headline: Every decision is timestamped, traceable, and auditable.
evidence_blocks.body: See exactly what data the model had, when it received it, and whether the signal fired before or after the price moved. No black boxes.

evidence_blocks.headline: The flattering number and the stricter number, side by side.
evidence_blocks.body: Aggregate profit factor looks great. Average daily profit factor tells you if the edge repeats. We show both so you can decide what matters.

evidence_blocks.headline: A live workstation, not a marketing dashboard.
evidence_blocks.body: Dense data, ranked tables, real-time state — designed for people who trade, not people who browse. Every pixel earns its place.
